title: JANUS Linear A SigLA fail-closed source-adapter contract

contract_scope.source: SigLA — The Signs of Linear A
contract_scope.purpose: Validate the technical identity of SigLA document root and native word-view pages before extracting any content observables.

admitted: Exact route grammar because it was observed on all three deterministic root probes and frozen before the word-view execution.
Two script sources and one stylesheet because they are exact three-way intersections across frozen word-view snapshots.
document-metadata and document-view classes because they are source-structural three-way intersections and directly describe page containers rather than inscription semantics.
[sign view] because it is a three-way common reciprocal navigation anchor that distinguishes native word view from the root/sign view.
not_required_even_though_common: Generic HTML tags such as body/div/span because they are non-discriminative.
Branding/navigation anchors such as Home/About/Help because they are interface decoration rather than word-view identity.
logo/search-content/sidebar-icon/title classes because they are not necessary to validate the transcription-view container.

preservation_rules: Preserve punctuation, numeric, fraction and uncertainty markers exactly as presented by SigLA until a separately frozen normalization rule exists.
Preserve source-specific sign IDs and document IDs without coercion into mwenge identifiers except through the already frozen document identity bridge.
Preserve disagreements as disagreements; never silently replace SigLA content with mwenge content.
forbidden: fallback to guessed DOM selectors when the contract fails
automatic a↔r or b↔v side/orientation remapping
using known Linear A candidates to choose documents
calling SigLA agreement external transcription replication
relaxing contract requirements after observing a desired content comparison

next_gate.goal: Using only the exact frozen three-page word-view artifact, derive a content-extraction schema candidate from DOM ancestry and repeated source-native structures without reading mwenge content or assigning sign/word semantics.
next_gate.why_before_content_audit: The interface is now identifiable, but a page-level adapter contract does not yet prove which DOM nodes correspond to source-native word units. A separate structural schema gate prevents content extraction from becoming an undocumented parser guess.
